scope: generic educational target-arrow taxonomy; not brand replicas
imagePolicy: Lancaster product photography used as remote visual reference only; no source images embedded

parts.title: Parallel cylindrical
parts.description: Constant external diameter. Representative dimensions use the published X10 Parallel Pro 600 size: 0.194 in OD, 32 in length.

parts.title: Barrelled
parts.description: Maximum diameter near the middle with reduced ends. Family is source-backed; exact X10 end diameters/taper stations are not published by Lancaster, so this is generic topology.

parts.title: Front taper
parts.description: Parallel rear/mid body tapering toward the point end. ProTour confirms the family; taper station and end diameter here are generic.

parts.title: Front-parallel / rear taper
parts.description: Parallel front body with a reduced rear section, based on the VXT front-parallel/rear-taper description. Exact dimensions are generic.

parts.title: Aluminium alloy
parts.description: Single aluminium-alloy tube, represented by an X7/XX75-style target-shaft construction.

parts.title: All-carbon
parts.description: Carbon-fibre shaft family such as Nano Pro/VXT; no aluminium core.

parts.title: Carbon over aluminium
parts.description: Carbon exterior bonded to a precision aluminium core, as in X10/A/C/E families. Layer thickness schematic only.

parts.title: Aluminium over carbon
parts.description: Carbon core with aluminium jacket (FMJ-style inverse construction). Included as construction taxonomy, not a target-arrow recommendation.

parts.title: Stainless break-off target point
parts.description: Glue-in stainless target point with break-off weight-adjustment steps. Lancaster documents Easton 4 mm HL as 130 to 80 gr in 10 gr increments and black-nickel stainless.

parts.title: Tungsten break-off target point
parts.description: Dense tungsten-alloy break-off family. Lancaster lists X10 Ballistic Tungsten at 100-120 gr; geometry here is generic, not an Easton replica.

parts.title: Aluminium glue-in bullet
parts.description: Rounded bullet-profile glue-in point for aluminium shafts; Lancaster lists 50-100 gr variants depending on shaft size.

parts.title: NIBB / long-shank target point
parts.description: Hardened steel point with an extra-long aluminium shank, matching Lancaster construction description.

parts.title: 8-32 screw-in bullet
parts.description: Machined steel bullet point with standard 8-32 threaded attachment. Head uses a representative 9/32 in class.

parts.title: 8-32 screw-in field point
parts.description: Narrow field-profile screw-in point, distinct from bullet shape; standard insert-thread concept.

parts.title: Glue-in chisel target point
parts.description: Steel glue-in chisel-style target point family. Generic educational silhouette.

parts.title: Direct-fit insert nock
parts.description: Nock stem inserts into a .166-class shaft/bushing. Groove is represented from Lancaster Easton N example (0.081 in groove); not a brand replica.

parts.title: Pin nock / small groove
parts.description: Polymer nock fitted onto a separate metal pin. Representative groove uses Beiter/Easton small-groove class around .088 in.

parts.title: Pin nock / large groove
parts.description: Same pin interface with a larger groove class around .098 in.

parts.title: Pin-out / over-shaft nock
parts.description: Nock fits the pin and extends over the end of the shaft, matching the Beiter Pin-Out attachment concept.

parts.title: Bushing-backed insert nock
parts.description: Metal rear bushing installed in the shaft with a replaceable insert nock, matching UNI/G-UNI/Super-UNI-style architecture.

parts.title: Conventional swaged/tapered rear
parts.description: Traditional aluminium-shaft nock swage/taper with a conventional replaceable nock.

parts.title: Rear impact collar
parts.description: Thin metal collar around the rear shaft end; Lancaster lists the X10 3.2 mm collar at 3 gr. Compatibility remains product-family-specific.

provenanceRules.published: dimension/material/interface stated on a Lancaster product or guide page
provenanceRules.photo-observed: visible silhouette/relationship only, never treated as a measurement
provenanceRules.generic-topology: family is source-backed but exact hidden or dimensional geometry is not published
